list: Cabo San Lucas|Cabo|Los Cabos|San Jose del Cabo
changes_vs_current: New topic. Scope: cities only, outside the 50 US states; islands and countries (Aruba/Oranjestad, Bali, Santorini, Maui, Tuscany, Cap Cana resort) excluded even when they appear in booking lists, while resort cities people name as cities (Cancun, Cabo San Lucas incl. San Jose del Cabo/Los Cabos, Punta Cana, Montego Bay) are kept. Raw average across the ten people lists (missing = length+5) gave London 3.1, Paris 3.5, Rome 4.3, Cancun 6.0, Dublin/Tokyo 9.2, Barcelona 10.2, Amsterdam 11.1, Cabo 11.3, Punta Cana 11.4, Venice 11.9, Vancouver 12.0, Montego Bay 12.3, Athens 12.6, Lisbon 12.7, Mexico City 12.9, then Vienna/Dubai/Toronto/Madrid/Sydney ~13. Gut-check moves: Paris put #1 over London (only city in all 10 lists, tops both polls and the Euromonitor tie-break; London's edge comes from airline hub bookings); Tokyo moved above Dublin (gut + United #3, Euromonitor #3); Venice up from #12 to #8 (gut; Hilton 23%, Talker 27%); Sydney up from ~#23 to #11 (gut; Hilton poll 22%, 1.17M pageviews; absent from booking lists due to distance/cost, not low recognition); Toronto up from ~#21 to #12 (gut; United #4, 1.58M pageviews); Florence added at #16 though absent from the top-10 lists (gut; 0.70M pageviews, Tuscany 16% in Talker); Punta Cana and Montego Bay nudged down below the gut-check cities since they are beach-package bookings more than named 'cities'. Tail (Vienna, Prague, Berlin) chosen by Cloudwards (Vienna #1) and pageviews among European capitals; Frankfurt and Calgary dropped as connecting hubs/gateways (Banff).
confidence: High for the top 3 (Paris, London, Rome appear in nearly every source) and high for Cancun, Tokyo, Barcelona, Dublin, Venice, Amsterdam in the top 10 (each in 3-6 people sources). Medium for 10-18: Cabo, Punta Cana and Montego Bay are driven by booking data and may be under- or over-named by players; Sydney and Toronto rest on one poll/booking list plus pageviews; Florence leans on pageviews and gut check only. Low for 19-24 (Dubai, Madrid, Montego Bay, Vienna, Prague, Berlin), which mostly rest on one list plus pageviews. The only true US city-wish-list poll found is from 2021 (Hilton/OnePoll); no YouGov international-city poll was reachable. Near misses: Rio de Janeiro, Quebec City, Edinburgh, Hong Kong, Singapore, Istanbul, Munich, Puerto Vallarta, Montreal, Kyoto, Seoul, Bangkok.
